title: Future Policy Approximation for Offline Reinforcement Learning in LLM Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2509.19893v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a key driver of post-training for complex reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet online RL introduces substantial instability and computational overhead. Offline RL offers a compelling alternative by decoupling generation from training; however, offline algorithms for reasoning remain under-optimized relative to their online counterparts. We revisit the potential of policy-gradient-style offline RL and address a central challenge in offline learning: gradient entanglement. In long-horizon reasoning trajectories, correct and incorrect solutions share substantial token overlap, causing gradient updates from incorrect trajectories to suppress tokens that are also critical for correct ones. translated_title: 面向大语言模型推理的离线强化学习中的未来策略近似
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）已成为大型语言模型（LLMs）复杂推理后训练的关键驱动力，然而在线RL引入了显著的稳定性和计算开销问题。离线RL通过将生成与训练解耦，提供了一种有吸引力的替代方案；然而，与在线算法相比，用于推理的离线算法仍优化不足。我们重新审视了策略梯度风格离线RL的潜力，并解决了离线学习中的一个核心挑战：梯度纠缠。在长视野推理轨迹中，正确和错误的解决方案共享大量令牌重叠，导致来自错误轨迹的梯度更新抑制了正确方案中同样关键的令牌。我们提出了未来策略近似（FPA），这是一种简单的离线策略梯度方法，它使用未来策略的估计而非当前策略来加权梯度，从而实现主动门控。
tldr: 本文提出未来策略近似（FPA）方法，通过基于未来策略而非当前策略的梯度加权，解决了离线强化学习中正确与错误推理轨迹的梯度纠缠问题，提升了LLM推理的离线训练效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Future Policy Approximation (FPA), a method that weights gradients using an estimate of the future policy rather than the current one, addressing gradient entanglement in offline RL for LLM reasoning and improving training efficiency.
